Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent behavior in the workplace. It has come to our notice that there have been multiple complaints about your conduct, which does not align with our company’s core values.

We expect all team members to uphold our professional standards and contribute to a positive work environment. Therefore, we require an immediate improvement in your behavior and strict adherence to these standards moving forward.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this matter further or if you need any support in making these adjustments.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
